title: ContextPack
description: A pluggable pre-dispatch context bundle assembled from sources (rg, git-log, memory, codegraph, ...). Categorical typed arrays enable per-source attribution + confidence ranking.

schema_version.description: 1 = original; 2 = adds context_hit_v1 optional fields (source_domain, why_relevant, trust_level, refs). Both versions are valid; v1 packs that omit new fields continue to validate.

name.description: Source identifier — e.g. rg, git-log, memory, codegraph. Free string; pluggable via core/context-pack/source.interface.md.

ref.description: What the item points at. File path, symbol fqn, memory slug, risk id.

source.description: Must match a sources[].name in this pack.

source_domain.description: Which index plane this item came from.

why_relevant.description: Human-readable explanation of why this item is relevant to the task.

trust_level.description: Reliability tier of the source that produced this item.

refs.description: Additional cross-references (e.g. related symbols, prior decisions).
